name: Drip 510 Cartridge | Sensi Star
description: Drip’s vape line has earned its massive popularity by utilizing some of the cleanest, highest-quality distillate available on the market. Deliciously potent, conveniently portable, all Drip products are rigidly tested and produced in our GMP certified facility right here in the heart of Mid-Michigan!
